description: Track daily habits with streaks and a 7-day history — check off today, build streaks, all saved on this device.

faqs.a: Add a habit, then tick it each day you complete it. The streak counts consecutive days up to today (or yesterday if today is not done yet).
Yes — habits and their history are stored in your browser's localStorage.
The 7-day strip shows the last 7 days with a dot for each completed day.
faqs.q: What does the week view show?

faqs.a: Use the delete button on a habit to remove it and its history.
Yes — everything stays in your browser.

howto: Add the habits you want to build.
Tick each habit on days you complete it.
Watch your streaks grow in the 7-day view.
title: Habit Tracker Lite
